children: D-Wave announced it will be a platinum sponsor at Quantum World Congress 2026 and will showcase annealing applications and updates to its dual-rail gate-model architecture.
Platinum sponsor at Quantum World Congress Sept 23–25 in College Park, Maryland, with booths 51 and 53.
Will present production results from annealing systems solving complex commercial and public-sector optimization problems.
Will provide updates on its dual-rail gate-model architecture aimed at reducing quantum error correction cost and complexity.
Executives, including Chief Science Officer Robert Schoelkopf and SVP Allison Schwartz, will lead plenary and panel sessions on multi-platform quantum use cases and policy.

title: D-Wave to Showcase Dual-Platform Quantum Strategy at Quantum World Congress 2026
